root_cause.text: In the media/vidtv transport-stream helpers, `vidtv_ts_null_write_into()` and `vidtv_ts_pcr_write_into()` accepted their argument structs by value, so callers copied possibly uninitialized stack structs into these functions and MSAN reported the copied shadow/origin metadata as uninitialized reads.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes both APIs in `drivers/media/test-drivers/vidtv/vidtv_ts.h` and `vidtv_ts.c` from `struct ... args` to `const struct ... *args`, and updates call sites in `vidtv_mux.c` to pass `&args`; the commit message explicitly states this was “causing MSAN to report uninit-value warnings” due to “the stack copy of the struct along with its MSAN shadow and origin metadata.”
